D.t: Marilyn Strickland leads by 27.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 75,435 votes; a one point swing is about 1,393 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +19.2 and D +34.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $0 helping Chris Chung and $391K helping Marilyn Strickland.
